model_descriptions.Linear Regression: Fits a linear equation to the features. Fast to train and interpret, but struggles with non-linear relationships common in agricultural data.
model_descriptions.Decision Tree: Learns a tree of decision rules. Can capture non-linear patterns but may overfit without depth limits. Single tree, easy to visualise.
model_descriptions.Random Forest: Ensemble of many decision trees. Generally more robust than a single tree. Provides native feature importance. Slower to train.

split_limitation: Rows from the same (Crop, State) pair may appear in both train and test sets. Performance may look stronger than on fully unseen crops or states.
target: Yield (log1p transformed during training; expm1 for output)
